rain_attenuation.standard: ITU-R P.838-3 (2005), specific attenuation model for rain
rain_attenuation.review_boundary: Numerical frequency-fit coefficients and circular-polarization combination checked against the pinned public reference implementation; primary ITU PDF not downloaded or claimed reviewed.
rain_attenuation.reviewed_component: class _ITU838_3_, rain_specific_attenuation_coefficients; frequency fits kH/kV/alphaH/alphaV, tau=45 degrees circular case
rain_attenuation.license: MIT, Copyright (c) 2016 Inigo del Portillo, Massachusetts Institute of Technology
rain_attenuation.formula: gamma_dB_per_km = k * R_mm_per_hour ** alpha; A_dB = gamma * rain_path_km; voltage factor = 10 ** (-A_dB/20)
rain_attenuation.limits: Uniform prescribed rain slab, scalar circular-polarization attenuation, no stochastic rain cells, P.618 exceedance/time-percentage prediction, rain phase/group delay or depolarization. Reflected rays use the same scalar approximation.

wet_delay_residual.model: Signed actual-minus-applied neutral wet-delay residual, constant refractivity contrast in a finite flat slab; not a humidity retrieval or rainfall relation
wet_delay_residual.derivation: delta(n-1)=delta_ZWD/(top-bottom); excess path=delta(n-1)*segment_length_inside_slab. Full straight-ray crossings give delta_ZWD/sin(elevation). Differentiate finite slab clipping for path rate; reflected paths sum both legs using the moving specular-point derivative.
wet_delay_residual.iq_application: Same nondispersive excess range added to code and carrier; derivative added to their rates/Doppler. Geometric ranges/rates and inverse-range amplitude remain geometric.
wet_delay_residual.parameter_status: Illustrative correction-error sensitivity levels; negative means over-correction, not negative physical water vapour. No empirical weather calibration or probability distribution.
wet_delay_residual.contextual_reference: Previously reviewed Sanwale et al. arXiv:2605.01553v1 Eq. (7) separates geometric and atmospheric delay. The flat residual slab and analytic derivatives here are our own geometry model, not a reproduced atmospheric mapping algorithm.
wet_delay_residual.limits: No bending, curved-Earth mapping, Niell/GMF coefficients, time evolution or horizontal wet gradients; common nominal atmosphere is assumed removed, only residual is injected. No antenna wetting.

wet_wall.model: Planar air / homogeneous lossy water film / semi-infinite substrate; coherent two-interface Fresnel composition
wet_wall.derivation: Separate s/p interface reflection coefficients with conserved tangential wavevector; r=(r01+r12*exp(-2j*k0*q1*d))/(1+r01*r12*exp(-2j*k0*q1*d)); existing circular receive-basis composition. In wall IQ multiply by exp(+2j*k0*cos(theta)*d) to reference the unchanged substrate plane while film replaces air.
wet_wall.parameter_status: Explicit illustrative assumed bulk complex permittivity, not measured wet concrete, not a temperature-dependent model or fitted rain experiment
wet_wall.rainfall_to_film_mapping: None: rate and thickness are independent sensitivity controls, including wet-after-rain cases
wet_wall.limits: Uniform smooth film only; no droplets, roughness, porosity/infiltration, patchy wetness, wet antenna or radome
